subject: Can R return a JSON back to the webpage

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Can R return a JSON back to the webpage
parts:
Hello,

I have a button called "Update View", which currently, takes the values from a collection of drop down boxes, retrieves some data, plots it and return an xyplot (which shiny shows as a PNG).

However, i would like to instead return a JSON (corresponding to the retrieved data) and use D3 to plot it.

Is this possible? Can I, when i press update view, get R to return a JSON?

Regards
saptarshi

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Can R return a JSON back to the webpage
parts:
This is definitely something that we're thinking about. In the released version of Shiny, though, there isn't a good way to do this.

We're working on some stuff right now that lays the groundwork for sending messages with arbitrary JSON data to the client. To do what you're looking for, we'll have to think a bit about how to make it possible for app authors to register handlers for the data when it's received by the client.

-Winston

parts:
My R package rCharts (http://ramnathv.github.io/rCharts/r2js/) might be of interest. It uses lattice style plotting interface to create interactive visualizations using different JS libraries. I have implemented NVD3, Polycharts and MorrisJS. Highcharts, Rickshaw and xCharts are in the process of being integrated.

Here are two Shiny apps created using rCharts

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ramnathv/rChartOECD/
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/ramnathv/rNVD3/

Hope this is of help.
